about: Help videos (Part 43): each is a (Video ...) G-code script the page plays live (js/page/help.js) and tools/record_demo.js records for YouTube. secs = about how long it plays live. kind: machine = the 3D view, ui = the whole page. Learn (Part 47): group = its heading in the Learn list (js/page/help.js LEARN_GROUPS), type: demo = on a temporary machine, mine = on your own (puts back what it moves).

videos.title: Tour + first job
videos.blurb: The Configure steps, then Run: Home, Zero and a name plate engraved on the page's own FluidNC.

videos.title: Why home?
videos.blurb: Switched on, the gantry is racked and the beam off level: $H squares it, each side to its own switch.

videos.title: Changing a bit
videos.blurb: On your router: the shaft held, the collet nut off, the bit (and its collet, for another shank) swapped and the nut back on.

videos.title: The touch plate out and back
videos.blurb: On your machine: the shoe's bottom off, the clip onto the collet nut, the plate under the bit - and all of it back.

videos.title: Probing and zero
videos.blurb: Work zero per axis, and the touch plate with its clip on the collet nut finding the stock's top.

videos.title: As built + tram
videos.blurb: A racked gantry, a router out of tram and a warped spoilboard, and the squareness test that finds them.

videos.title: Your own front plate
videos.blurb: The template, your SVG uploaded and checked, the plate in 3D, and the job's V-bit and bit change.

videos.title: Safety: lost steps + fire
videos.blurb: A knot makes X skip steps; Z losing a few steps on each lift ends in a jammed bit, smoke and a fire. Never leave it running.
